scientific_integrity: The all-degree proof is by explicit affine coordinate algebras, finite normalization and regular-sequence lengths; the finite exact-arithmetic checker supports rather than replaces the proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one omitted degree-d monomial on complex P^2 for \(d\ge3\); no nonmonomial projection or multiple omissions; a smooth projective image need not have a normal homogeneous coordinate ring. Historical full-text comparison with Schenzel (1978) remains incomplete.
title: Three geometric regimes for one-monomial projections of Veronese surfaces
